items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, we had a quartet for a while that Geoff was in, and it had been a trio…

ctx.x: It’s… well, I think I’ve alluded to it, anyway, all the way through. I enjoy taking musical chances and either surviving or not, and you try to find… Oh, we had a quartet for a while that Geoff was in, and it had been a trio… I can’t remember… but somehow we ended up going to Europe as a quartet, and I thought, well, we don’t really need a piano in the quartet ‘cause I’m playing chords. But what would happen, often, on concerts, when it came time for Geoff to play solo, he would take a little bit of the tune, and…
Well, what about the Frisell collaboration?
